requirements.quote: We are currently soliciting bid quotations or proposals from NY State certified M/WBE firms for any tasks of the work contained in this contract.
requirements.text: Submit bid quotations or proposals if you are a NY State certified M/WBE firm.

requirements.quote: The Workplan and specifications are currently available at our office for your review.
requirements.text: Review the Workplan and specifications available at the office.

requirements.quote: If you are interested in participation on this project, please complete and submit a copy of the MBE/WBE Contractor Participation Bid/Proposal (SRAA - 5008) no later than thirty (30) days from the (due date).
requirements.text: Submit the MBE/WBE Contractor Participation Bid/Proposal (SRAA - 5008) within 30 days of the due date.

requirements.quote: If you need additional information and assistance, or need to review the Work Plan and specifications, please contact (authorized representative) of our office at (telephone).
requirements.text: Contact the authorized representative for additional information or to review the Work Plan and specifications.

requirements.quote: In the event that you cannot bid on this contract please complete the attached Minority/Women's Contractor Unavailability Certification Form (SRAA - 5009).
requirements.text: Complete the Minority/Women's Contractor Unavailability Certification Form (SRAA - 5009) if unable to bid.
